name: Elif Demir
bio:
Elif Demir's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Turkish rally events with her father. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at Istanbul Technical University, excelling in precision manufacturing and materials science. After graduating, she joined a local racing team as a junior machinist, quickly proving her skill in maintaining and optimizing race car components. Her meticulous attention to detail and ability to adapt to the fast-paced environment caught the eye of Red Bull Racing scouts, leading to her current role.

As a machinist for Red Bull Racing, Elif is responsible for crafting and refining critical engine and chassis parts. She thrives on the challenge of pushing the boundaries of performance and reliability. Her flexible approach allows her to collaborate effectively with engineers and mechanics, finding innovative solutions to complex problems. Elif's commitment to perfection and unwavering loyalty make her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elif has a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting a task.
Has a small collection of miniature tools on her workbench.
Prefers to listen to Turkish folk music while working.
